reasoning_quality_informational.final_root_problem: Disputes doubled from August (590 in July to 1180 in August) while response times are within SLA (E-02, E-03), so the cause lies upstream in wrong or estimated bills. The best-supported mechanism is that manual reads are incomplete or late (route completion 88% vs 95% target, E-06, E-07), so billing substitutes estimates that trigger disputes. This is falsifiable: it predicts estimated-read disputes rose from August, and it does not cover the 1785 actual-read disputes.
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
